description:
Functional specifications covered / files: lib/zaq/channels/delivery/plan.ex, plan/step.ex, attachments.ex; channels/api.ex
Adapt old metadata packing and steps as internal Channel modules. Planner accepts outgoing and once-resolved requirements, returns a separate plan. Resolve selected outbound configuration and normalized snapshot through existing boundary; use TransportRequirements.resolve(snapshot, selected_connection), never bridge-owned requirements derivation. Support positive, not_applicable and optional unresolved ceilings distinctly. Enforce known limits, retain unknown facts and downstream provider checks; never claim unknown is unlimited. No selection-error fallback notices.

Tests to add before implementation: Ordering/count/size packing properties; stable indices; no materialization in planner; explicit edit capability; unsupported/unavailable/invalid/required-unresolved failure paths; empty attachments bypass all planning.

Branches/paths validated: Ordering/count/size packing properties; stable indices; no materialization in planner; explicit edit capability; unsupported/unavailable/invalid/required-unresolved failure paths; empty attachments bypass all planning.

Action reuse assessment: Local-only orchestration using existing requirements resolver and FileSettings, not a tool/Action. Pure planner has no actor or IO effects. Concrete policy for failed resolution must be documented before implementation.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.

comments.text: PR4 scope: planner returns a separate Channel-local plan; requirements are supplied from the PR2 resolver. Do not enable a production delivery route that cannot yet execute attachments. Runtime integration belongs to PR5; metadata planning performs no acquisition.

Reconciled PR4 contract before implementation: build_plan(outgoing, resolved_requirements, existing_message_id \\ nil) returns {:ok, plan} separately, {:ok, nil} for empty attachments, or {:error, reason}. Supplied resolver {:error, reason} is propagated unchanged. No Api/bridge route changes, policy execution, omission/fallback notices, or per-plan runtime state. Invalid metadata reports original index and rejects plan; groups/steps retain ordered original indices even for repeated Record IDs. Optional unknown sizes/limits remain unknown and require actual-content/provider validation; known raw lower bounds constrain packing, exact encoded requests remain PR5. Edits require explicit supports_attachment_edits and supplied existing ID. Tests before code: metadata errors/indexing, nil/known sizes, positive/NA/unresolved limits, grouping/count/upload bounds, ordering properties, explicit edits and pure lazy records with invalid handles; resolver integration failure cases. Action reuse remains local-only using supplied PR2 results; pure constraints/metadata helpers are shared with acquisition. Owning docs channels.md; mocks unnecessary for pure planner.

title: [zaq-6rc.3] Build Channel-local metadata delivery plans
